name: ExpressText+
author: Zoidium
description: Tracked-letter text effector stack: its Custom properties + offers only Shake, Plain, Random, Formula, Delay, Spline, Orbit, Repeater, Twist, Wrap and Voronoi with letter fields and C4D-style animation.

objectTypes.name: ExpressText+
objectTypes.desc: Track separate letters, then add Shake, Plain, Random, Formula, Delay, Spline, Orbit, Repeater, Twist, Wrap and Voronoi effectors with the + control.

objectClasses.name: ExpressText+
objectClasses.description: Tracks separate 3D text letters for the effector stack. Effectors are added with the + control, never from the picker.
